cells.D: A Certification of Address form would need to be completed. If someone resides with you at the residence with you, the individual would have to supply us with a household document such as: tax bill or deed or lease agreement or mortgage statement ALONG with a supporting document dated within the last 60 days: (e.g., credit card statement, water, gas, gas, electric, cellphone bill) If the individual that resides with you, will not be present, the Cert of Address Form would have to be notarized, and the household & supporting document would have to be accompanied with application.
